edge_count.note: The number of edges of a simple graph: the cardinality of the upstream edge set E(G) of unordered adjacent pairs. The adjacent ordered pairs taken in one orientation (enum_rank order) have the same count, unconditionally (edge_count_rank); both orientations give twice as much. K_0 and K_1 have no edge, K_2 one, K_3 three, K_n C(n,2) (edge_count_Kn), and the count is an isomorphism invariant (edge_count_diso).
